maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue is new fiber and wireless network construction for telecom carriers; locating and maintenance are smaller parts.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private telecom providers (AT&T, Verizon, Lumen, Comcast) and utilities; government funding like BEAD is only indirect.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through organic work for large telecom customers; acquisitions are occasional, not the main growth route.

mission_critical.reason: Contractors for telecom construction can be rebid or swapped; carriers use multiple contractors, though locating is safety-related.

notes: Switching difficulty is moderate; carriers use several contractors and master service agreements, so the answer is a judgment call.
